description: Use to start seat alerts on one flight, after the traveler confirms: named seats, or every seat of a kind (window, aisle, middle, any), optionally only when N seats open together in a row. Alerts go to the account's channels when a watched seat opens.

cabin.description: Cabin to look at; any = every cabin on the flight.
cabin.title: Cabin

destination.description: A 3-letter airport code (JFK), or a city code that searches every airport in the city (SlickTrip's 4-letter codes: NYCA New York, LOND London, ROME Rome, TYOA Tokyo). Up to 3 places joined with _ search them together (JFK_EWR). A place name works when one place clearly matches; otherwise the result is an unknown_place error listing suggestions. When the traveler names a city rather than an airport, send the city (its name or code), not one of its airports: one airport can miss the cheapest or the only flights. Unsure of the code: call find_places.
destination.title: Destination

email.description: Send alerts by email. Empty keeps the account's setting.
email.title: Email

flight_number.description: Airline code and number, no space.
flight_number.title: Flight Number

origin.description: A 3-letter airport code (JFK), or a city code that searches every airport in the city (SlickTrip's 4-letter codes: NYCA New York, LOND London, ROME Rome, TYOA Tokyo). Up to 3 places joined with _ search them together (JFK_EWR). A place name works when one place clearly matches; otherwise the result is an unknown_place error listing suggestions. When the traveler names a city rather than an airport, send the city (its name or code), not one of its airports: one airport can miss the cheapest or the only flights. Unsure of the code: call find_places.
origin.title: Origin

seat_type.description: Watch every open seat of this kind instead of naming seats.
seat_type.title: Seat Type

seats_together.description: Alert only when this many seats are open together in one row, 2-6.
seats_together.title: Seats Together

text.description: Send alerts by text message. Needs a verified phone on the SlickTrip account; empty keeps the account's setting.
text.title: Text

name: track_seats

cabin.description: Cabin tracked, or list when several

channels.description: Alert channels on the record: email, text (booleans)

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

flight.description: flight_number, origin, destination, departure_time, arrival_time, aircraft, airline

merged_with_existing.description: Added to an existing seat alert

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

title: Track seats on a flight
